The discussion focused on understanding how various advertising metrics are calculated. Specifically, [p1] needs help detailing the calculation of metrics based on selected active hours and slots, and how to calculate overall occupancy.

This knowledge is required for building a scheduler intended for displaying advertisements on a player.

decisions: Use a specific spreadsheet template to model and clarify metric calculations.
